limitations.detail: The vendor recipe runs cargo update cc before cargo cinstall. The cached build log does not retain the resulting Cargo.lock. The archived original lockfile and its packages do not prove the final versions of this build tool and any dependencies changed by that command.

Notice collection covers discovered source notice files, embedded NVIDIA notices, Rust library copyright materials and Cargo manifests. A conservative superset includes unused platforms/tests. Some upstream crates declare MIT in Cargo.toml without a separate notice; those original manifests are retained. This collection is not a completed legal or runtime-linkage review.
Source archives are retained privately with hashes. A binary publication must make required source/build materials available to its recipients; no public source download has been published.
